audience: shop owners and ERP teams that push product data to marketplaces through Channel Pilot Pro

useCases.title: Check whether the last upload was imported
useCases.text: List the feeds of the shop. Then read the status of one feed: its last upload and its last import.

useCases.title: Check what a feed stored
useCases.text: Read the product data a feed stored for an offset range, to check what was sent. The data is kept for three days.

useCases.title: Update prices and stock by SKU
useCases.text: Send the fields to change for each product, with its SKU. Missing products are created. Then check the import.

useCases.title: Remove discontinued products from a feed
useCases.text: Send the identifier fields of each discontinued product. The products are removed from the shop data in Channel Pilot Pro.
